text: Experiment 17 used the sculpture's texts as a running key, but only on the two known alphabets. Sanborn called his table slightly different, so here its alphabet may be any order of the 26 letters.

Each known letter gives one equation: the carved letter's position equals the message letter's plus the key letter's. Solved mod 2 and mod 13, they show whether two letters are forced into one position.
80,676 settings: no alphabet fits K4 for any of them, while the scrambled coppers manage 0 to 57. K4 sits at the bottom of the range.
